decision: docs/DECISIONS.md D23 final answer (a): bundle the regional route relations
warning: UNVERIFIED regional data. No closure check, no surface audit and no measured traffic. Every trail here must be loaded with verified=false; away from home most roads grade UNGRADED. See docs/REGIONAL-TRAILS.md.

licence.name: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap)
licence.note: This file is a Derivative Database of OpenStreetMap data and stays under the ODbL.

region.description: Washington state + the Portland metro and the northern Willamette Valley (D23)
region.clipping: geometry is clipped to the union of these boxes. Without this a relation keeps every member the extract holds, including members far outside the region (measured before: a coordinate range of lat 42.307..55.354, lon -131.714..-116.996, i.e. Alaska).
region.boundary_leg_note: the leg that crosses a box edge is dropped, so a clipped length under-estimates the in-region length by less than one leg per crossing.

simplification.rationale: 10 m chosen over 20 m: 20 m would save only about 0.3 MB and the file is inside the few-MB budget either way, while 10 m halves the length error (0.44% short of the source geometry against 0.80%) and keeps the drawn shape on the correct side of a junction, because 10 m is about one lane width.

selection.invariant: every shipped metre is off-road; `segments` contains no road geometry

field_notes.length_km_clipped: measured on the SIMPLIFIED geometry after clipping to the region: the length the app may use
field_notes.length_km_source_unclipped: the whole relation as assembled from the source, before clipping: provenance only, never rideable length
field_notes.segments: one or more contiguous chains of [lat, lon]. EVERY metre of these is off-road: on-road and unknown-highway member pieces are removed at build time and never joined across, so the app (which grades trail geometry Grade A by construction) cannot grade a road metre as trail. Pieces may therefore be several rideable spans, like the Sumner Link closure case.
field_notes.onroad_km_removed: clipped road geometry that belonged to this relation in OSM and was removed from `segments`
field_notes.offroad_share: share of the SOURCE relation's CLIPPED member-way length whose highway class is off-road (cycleway/path/footway/bridleway/track/pedestrian/steps). Everything below 0.90 is not bundled at all, and inside a bundled relation only the off-road part reaches `segments`.
field_notes.offroad_km: the off-road part of offroad_share, in km

sources.label: Portland metro, OR

duplicate_geometry_same_name.note: identical shipped points under two relation ids: a duplicate mapping in OSM (names may differ)

dropped_on_shipped_geometry.criterion: measured on the simplified geometry the app actually reads, not on the source geometry
